source_text.GH#2697: PR 1 test-design gate: restricted-field request walker (query, join query, export), SEC R1-R6, code-gate B1.

task.description: Round 2 diff check of HEAD bed9c17ded against round-1 gaps G1, G2, A1, A2. Static review only (no mix run, no edits to tests).

result.summary: PASS (round 2, static diff review of bed9c17ded; hosted CI green at this head on all three backend shards per ORCH). G1 FIXED: misnamed with_direct_join renamed with_filter (still the through-join case); new describe 'B1 export, DIRECT join' uses fk_ctx! and sends the real @fk_join (alone and with @filter_true) to ghost_q, asserting plain export is 404 and whole/1 (status, body, sorted headers) is identical for both. G2 FIXED: unit test now pins {:error, :entity_type_not_found}, killing the direct-join variant of M11 at unit level. A1 FIXED: T-18c retitled to state it asserts the route-level :EntitiesRecordsExport gate, not the unredacted-permission check (limitation remains documented, accepted). A2/M8 FIXED: new test 'audit insert happens BEFORE the records query' attaches telemetry on [:letflow, :repo, :query] (same pattern as existing T-30 handler), filters by self()==pid so only the request process counts, records SQL in order, and asserts index of first INSERT INTO ..."audit_entries" < index of first SELECT on entity_record_latest, with is_integer guards so a missing event fails loudly. Mutant reasoning: entities.ex export path runs audit_exempted (line ~2405) before Cursor.paginate (~2407); moving audit after paginate puts the entity_record_latest SELECT (Cursor builds on the Latest schema) first, so audit_idx > records_idx and the assertion fails. Allowlist/Compiler/Guard contain no entity_record_latest queries, so no earlier SELECT can produce a false pass. Brittleness: depends on Ecto telemetry event name and SQL text substrings (quoted schema-qualified audit_entries, entity_record_latest), but the repo already uses the identical event in T-30 and other tests, the handler is a named capture, detach is in an after block, unique handler id, async false; harmless brittleness (a rename fails loudly via the is_integer guards, not silently). No new skips, TODOs, secrets or inter-test dependencies in the diff; git status shows only an unrelated untracked instances_restricted_field_events_test.exs and handoffs dir. Caveat: I did not execute the suite or apply the M8 mutant (brief: read-only, no mix); the claim rests on source-order reading plus green CI.
